title: Musk Brings the Grok Voice System to Starlink: Handles 15,000 Calls Daily and Completes 3,000 Orders Weekly
excerpt: Recently, the space exploration technology company led by Elon Musk, SpaceX, has made significant progress in the practical application of AI technology. Accord
content_html:
Recently, the space exploration technology company led by Elon Musk, SpaceX, has made significant progress in the practical application of AI technology. According to Musk, the Starlink project has now widely implemented the Grok voice system and is fully utilizing it for daily customer support and sales operations.

The Grok voice system, a central AI product in Tesla and xAI ecosystem, has demonstrated remarkable practicality and processing efficiency in this business implementation. According to the latest operational data released by the SpaceX AI team, this AI voice system currently handles more than 15,000 customer inquiries and sales-related calls daily from around the world.

With the support of a large number of consultation accesses, the Grok voice system not only responds to various user business questions but also achieves actual results—processing over 3,000 transactions independently per week. This achievement shows that the speech interaction technology of large language models has moved beyond the theoretical verification stage and possesses strong implementation capabilities in large-scale commercial customer service and sales scenarios.

From the perspective of technological development, the deep integration of the Grok voice system into the extensive operational scenarios of Starlink not only significantly reduces the operating costs of traditional human customer service and sales teams within the company, but also opens up a new path for intellectual transformation in frequent business interactions around the world.
